cases.query: Our company purchased a private motor car within the blocked input tax category and no exception applies. Does business use alone allow recovery of the GST?
cases.messageText:
# Answer

Business use alone does not allow recovery of the GST when a company purchases a private motor car within the blocked input tax category and no exception applies. [IRAS: GST (General) Regulations](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/goods-services-tax-(gst)/claiming-gst-(input-tax)/conditions-for-claiming-input-tax)

cases.query: We employ a covered employee in Singapore. Who is responsible for paying the monthly CPF contribution to the Fund: the employer or the employee?
cases.messageText:
# Answer

Every employer of an employee is required to pay monthly to the Fund in respect of each employee contributions at the respective rates prescribed in the First Schedule.

cases.query: Our Singapore company plans to start regulated fund management. What should it establish about licensing or exemptions before commencing?
cases.messageText:
# Answer

A person carrying on a regulated activity in Singapore must assess whether a Capital Markets Services licence, registration, or a statutory or MAS exemption applies before conducting fund management.

Before commencing regulated fund management, your Singapore company must establish whether a Capital Markets Services licence, registration, or a statutory or MAS exemption applies to its planned activities.
